ops.loadingHours: Use of a banquet hall, including setup through removal, must be completed within the contracted time. Overruns incur an additional fee according to the time exceeded, and an overrun may not be possible if the next banquet requires the room. For the delivery and removal of equipment by contractors that the customer requests directly with the hotel's consent, and for signage size, mounting method and placement, follow the hotel's instructions (if a hotel staff member must be present, the cost of the attendant is paid). Decoration, flowers, sound, lighting, attractions and gifts are in principle arranged through hotel-designated vendors; to request a non-designated vendor directly, the hotel's prior consent is required and a separate fee based on the hotel's standards applies. When sending packages to the hotel, notify the person in charge of the contents in advance and write the date of use, event name and applicant (company) name on the package. (Banquet Hall Terms of Use, revised January 1, 2025)
ops.parking: Times Parking (operated by Times 24) on basement levels 2 and 3 of the hotel. 102 spaces, vehicle height limit 2.1 m, open all year, 600 yen per 30 minutes. Basement level 1 cannot be used. Banquets get up to 3 hours free (a 3-hour free ticket is issued for banquet use).
ops.waitingRooms: When the grand banquet halls "Hisho" and "Shoun" are used, the small banquet rooms on the same floor can be used as breakout rooms or waiting rooms (3F Kiyosu, Ryogoku, Kuramae and Sakura; 4F Kototoi, Azuma and Komagata). Areas: Kiyosu 65㎡, Ryogoku 55㎡, Kuramae 55㎡, Kototoi 100㎡, Azuma 100㎡, Komagata 120㎡. The 3F has a smoking room, cloakroom and changing room, and the 4F has a smoking area and a nursing room.
ops.catering: Banquet plans include a plan that bundles food and free-flow drinks (120 minutes). Light meals (boxed lunches) start from 2,200 yen (as stated on the MICE page).
ops.restaurants: The restaurants and bars in the hotel are Sky Grill Buffet Musashi (武藏) (26F), THE ASAKUSA DINING (27F; Chinese cuisine "唐紅花" / French cuisine "Makie" (蒔絵)), THE LOBBY BAL (1F), THE LOUNGE (1F), THE TOP BAR Hanabi -華美- (28F), and Sweets & Bakery 穂乃華 (1F). For receptions that accompany meetings, the official banquet and meeting page says that a wide range of banquet plans, from buffet style to seasonal cuisine, is available.
